scope: MEASURED synthetic local workerd, no production CPU

objects.name: candidates_source_time
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX candidates_source_time ON content_candidates(source_id,published_at DESC,id)

objects.name: stories_feed
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX stories_feed ON canonical_stories(team_id,publication_state,meaningful_update_at DESC,latest_evidence_at DESC,id DESC)

objects.name: stories_first_report
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX stories_first_report ON canonical_stories(team_id,first_reported_at DESC,id DESC)

objects.name: stories_importance
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX stories_importance ON canonical_stories(team_id,importance_score DESC,meaningful_update_at DESC,id DESC)

objects.name: videos_published
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX videos_published ON film_room_videos(published_at DESC,video_id)

objects.name: edition_team_date
objects.definition:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX edition_team_date ON three_and_out_snapshots(team_id,briefing_date)
  WHERE briefing_date IS NOT NULL AND status='PUBLISHED'

objects.name: checks_source_time
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX checks_source_time ON source_checks(source_id,attempted_at DESC,id)

objects.name: videos_available_time
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX videos_available_time ON film_room_videos(availability,published_at DESC,video_id DESC)

objects.name: editions_published
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX editions_published ON three_and_out_snapshots(team_id,status,generated_at DESC,id DESC)

objects.name: stories_team_page
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX stories_team_page ON canonical_stories(team_id,publication_state,meaningful_update_at DESC,id DESC)

objects.name: jobs_exhausted
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX jobs_exhausted ON ingestion_jobs(owner_epoch,status,available_at,lease_until,id) WHERE attempts>=max_attempts

objects.name: lean_hot_due
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX lean_hot_due ON lean_versions(strategy,published_at,kind,id,revision) WHERE inline_json IS NOT NULL

objects.name: app_one_primary_team
objects.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX app_one_primary_team ON app_team_follows(user_id) WHERE is_primary=1

objects.name: app_security_audit_owner
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX app_security_audit_owner ON app_security_audit(user_id,created_at DESC)

objects.name: app_token_expiry
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX app_token_expiry ON app_tokens(expires_at,id) WHERE consumed_at IS NOT NULL

objects.name: app_reward_history
objects.definition: CREATE INDEX app_reward_history ON app_reward_events(user_id,created_at DESC,id)
